workflows.description: Extract routes, parameters, and declared identity gates from the supplied source copy
prerequisites: A supplied read-only source snapshot; deployment exposure is not established.

workflows.description: Send one bodyless same-origin GET or HEAD baseline per in-scope route
prerequisites: Authorized same-origin public GET retrieval through p2o_http.

workflows.description: Reach protected routes with a controlled authenticated identity; a browser session is not a substitute
prerequisites: An explicitly authorized authenticated test transport and controlled principals; not provided by P2O.
